grade_reason: No statement by Houston Gaines about AI since 1 January 2025 was found in seven web searches or on his campaign site.
notes: Seven web searches ran, none refused; none returned a statement by Gaines about AI. The campaign site houstongaines.com was opened and does not mention AI (it lists 'Supporting Digital Assets' as an issue, with no detail). A FastDemocracy search result (https://fastdemocracy.com/bill-search/ga/2023_24/bills/GAB00026299) appears to list Gaines among sponsors of a 2023-24 Georgia House bill on state agency AI inventories; it was not opened, is before the 2025 period, and is about government AI use, not catastrophic risk, so it is left out. No source shows him sponsoring the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act. Search results were dominated by the city of Houston; a reviewer could check his Georgia House floor remarks and local Athens news if more coverage is wanted.
